text: SignalRAG should expose controller and evidence events directly in the demo.
Decomposition must be bounded and benchmarked rather than assumed to improve final ranking.
Grounding evaluation must verify real claim-to-chunk support.
A lightweight revision state machine is preferable to a second autonomous agent for the first prototype.
The broader copilot can expose typed tools, while the live path retains a deterministic baseline for ablation.
The public execution graph should mirror telemetry nesting.
